mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive S&P 500 forward return correction over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates rate hikes.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns do not deviate from the mean of the prior 30-day period, or CPIAUCSL remains below 0.3 for 4 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in PAYEMS labor claims exceeding the prior month's level by 10% predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days as investors interpret strength in job creation.
failure_condition: Across 50 such triggers, less than 40% of forward returns are positive, or the effect is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO manufacturing index below 50 signals supply-side weakness, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as investor sentiment turns cautious.
failure_condition: Over 12 such months, the average 20-day forward return is non-negative, or INDPRO recovers to >50 within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising HOUST retail sales above prior month's levels by at least 2% generate a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days as demand growth is expected to sustain earnings momentum.
failure_condition: Triggered 10 times but 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in a single month, the S&P 500 shows a negative 20-day forward return as markets anticipate tighter policy and lower valuations.
failure_condition: 10 such events, but no negative 20-day forward returns observed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 3% for three consecutive months indicates labor market softening, leading to a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 days as rate-cut expectations rise.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE[t] < 3.0 and UNRATE[t-1] >= 3.0 and UNRATE[t-2] >= 3.0 and UNRATE[t-3] >= 3.0
failure_condition: Triggered 5 times but 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (merchandising demand) by at least 5% in the same month creates a significant negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days due to dual demand weakness.
failure_condition: Over 20 such events, less than 30% of forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-crisis recovery regime (as defined by low inflation and rising employment), a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days is expected when UNRATE < 3% and PAYEMS > 150,000.
failure_condition: In 100 such regime windows, less than 60% of forward returns are positive.
